name: crystal-cluster
description: A fantasy crystal cluster: a tall central crystal and a seeded spray of smaller ones leaning out of a faceted rock base. Every crystal is a six-sided prism with a pointed six-faced tip and sharp facet edges, in a translucent shell around a glowing core. Colour (amethyst, clear quartz, emerald, ice blue), the glow, the count, the spread and the height are parameters; the seed changes the arrangement.

params.name: size
params.description: Width of the cluster in metres.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of crystals around the central one.

params.name: tall
params.description: Crystal length as a multiple of the usual (1).

params.name: spread
params.description: How far the crystals lean and spread out (0.2 is a tight bundle).

params.name: colour
params.description: 1 amethyst (violet), 2 clear quartz, 3 emerald (green), 4 ice (pale blue).

params.name: glow
params.description: A glowing core inside each crystal (an emissive material that reads in the dark).

params.name: seed
params.description: Seed for the arrangement and the base.
